relationship_to_historical_target: Separate bounded extension: Boolean/conditional operators and numeric functions extend beyond frozen kinetic-core-v0.1; old corpus reuse is not target conformance.

syntax.piecewise: One or more ordered arguments: value/condition pairs plus optional otherwise; otherwise-only allowed.
syntax.boolean_call_rejections: Lowercase calls and every nonzero-argument Boolean call reject Syntax; null MathML from reference is not supported evidence.

normalization.logical: Equal-precedence left-associative AND/OR; outer infix appends same-kind left node, even functional. Outer functions retain nested children; right subtrees stay nested.
normalization.deferred_chains: Infix comparison rejects normalized left comparison or AND with at least two direct comparison children. Unary simplification happens before this check.

evaluation.finite_context_conversion: Boolean to numeric 1/0; finite numeric zero false, other finite values true. Unknown never becomes zero or false.
evaluation.piecewise: Demand conditions in order and selected value only; first unknown condition gives unknown; known no-match without otherwise rejects initialization only.
evaluation.logical: Sequential demand; first decisive known Boolean stops; first unknown stops with unknown; demanded nonfinite domain rejects initialization.
evaluation.comparisons: Eagerly demand all operands, retaining known domain errors even beside unknown; compare successive pairs, not left-fold Boolean results.
evaluation.static: All branches participate in references, cycles, dimensional checking and finite literal restrictions regardless of demand.

retained_exclusions: Infix comparison chains including relational-AND and simplified wrappers
Rules, events, delay, user-defined functions and hierarchy
Nonfinite constants and existing scalar/rational restrictions
A solver or general simulation-readiness guarantee
